metadata.description: Unofficial Anthropic University learning plugin by Patrick King for Claude Code, the Claude desktop app, and Claude chat: certification prep for all four Claude exams plus 13 learning lanes, including partner tracks. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

plugins.name: anthropic-university
plugins.description: Learn Claude end to end: study plans and role paths, 13 learning lanes (use, build, administer, partner & industry), adaptive quizzes, official-format mock exams, flashcards, concept explainers, answer grading, client role-play for partners, Quizlet/Anki export, and contributor tools. Mapped to the official exam guides, grounded live via Claude Code Docs and Microsoft Learn connectors, with bundled banks for all four certification tracks.
